asr.full_text: Hello everyone! Today I will show you in detail how to earn money exchanging Litecoin with a very favorable rate. I have already executed this exchange twice, and it works fine. You can earn around 7% per round, and the exchange takes up to 30 minutes. Today we will use the $50trade exchange and I'll tell you right away that there are limits on the exchange. You can execute the exchange only three times with a maximum amount of twenty thousand USDT per round it's important not to exceed these limits as they may require verification I can't wait to show you everything in practice so let's get started we are on the trade spot tap in the Litecoin USDT trading pair first we enter the amount we want to buy LTC for 10 000 USDT. We make the purchase and see a notification about the order being opened and executed. I ended up with almost 112, 5.5 Litecoins. Next in the Wallet section we select the Fiat and Spott tab Find LTC and click on Withdraw. We see that the deposit is in the balance, so we can proceed. We go to the 50TradesExchange, register, or login to our account. In the exchange tab, we checked the Litecoin's price at the TOP. Currently, LTC is 8% more expensive on this exchange, but the spread may vary. Once the strategy is no longer profitable, I will remove this video from the channel. Nevertheless, always verify the profitability. We return to the home tab, find LTC and click on deposit. We need to enter the exchange amount so I copy the number of coins directly from the Binance wallet, paste it and click on get address the exchange request has been created and the address is provided here we need to send LTC to this address basically to the address and the network is automatically identified as LTC, enter the same amount again We confirm that the address is correct and proceed with a security verification I will speed up the entry of verification codes and wait for the deposit to be credited to the exchange I refreshed the page until the exchange was completed. Like the first two times it took less than fifteen minutes. Now our Litecoins should be in the balance. Now comes the easiest and most exciting part. We need to exchange litecoins for USDT. Go to the exchange tab in the left window, indicate that we are giving LTC. And in the right window, Receiving USDT. Go to the exchange tab in the left window. Indicate that we are giving LTC and in the right window receiving USDT. Enter the amount of coins we have in the balance. Now you can clearly see our earnings a very good spread let's make the exchange. In the upper right corner we see a notification about a successful exchange. Let's go back to the home tab. US DT is here. Now we send everything back to Binance to convert it into USD or any other convenient currency in the future. Click on withdrawal and select the TRC-20 network at the top. Then we need to return to Binance to get the USDT address. Go to the wallet in the Fiat & Spot section. Select USDT and click on deposit. Choose the same network as on the exchange, I choose TRC 20. Make sure to select the correct network for your case. Now copy the address address and go back. Go back to Binance to the transaction history section and wait for the deposit. That's how you receive the funds from the first two rounds. You can rotate any convenient capital and earn a 7% profit from each round, but the minimum limit is $300 USDT. While we wait for the deposit, don't forget to subscribe to our YouTube channel, like this video, or reach us on Telegram! The money has arrived in our balance, and you can see our profit! Thank you for watching, friends! I wish you success!
